answer: Scoped Liability Pools: each identity must anchor a small, publicly visible pool of real funds that pays out to anyone harmed by that identity's actions. A lotus of shared exposure grows as agents transact, so a clone inherits the pool's full liability but none of its earned history. Every accepted action emits a ripple others can claim against, meaning a sybil cluster must fund each clone's pool independently. Cloning costs one fully funded pool per identity with no vine of trust to amortize it across.
